items.question: What degree of rarity does the day called Mahānavamī possess in the three worlds?
premises: That day is designated by the name Mahānavamī.
Its status is evaluated across the three worlds.
It is characterized as exceedingly difficult to obtain.
items.inference: Therefore, the day called Mahānavamī is exceedingly rare throughout the three worlds.
